name: samples
description: List of sample definitions included in the analysis

name: samples[].sample_id
description: Unique identifier for the sample; used to link files and results

name: samples[].kinship
description: Familial relationship of the sample (e.g. proband, mother, brother, or unknown)

name: samples[].status
description: Disease status of the individual (affected, unaffected, or unknown)

name: samples[].sex
description: Biological sex of the sample (male or female or unknown)

name: samples[].code
description: Integer code representing the sample, typically used in pedigree-based analyses

name: samples[].bam
description: Path to the aligned, sorted, and haplotagged BAM file for the sample

name: samples[].coverage
description: Path to the per-base or per-region coverage file (e.g. mosdepth output)

name: paths
description: Collection of global file paths used across the analysis

name: paths.snvs_vcf
description: Phased and annotated SNV/indel VCF file for the primary sample set

name: paths.snvs_tsv
description: Tabular representation of SNVs derived from the VCF

name: paths.snvs_vcf_cohort
description: Cohort-level phased and annotated SNV/indel VCF file

name: paths.svs_vcf
description: Phased and annotated structural variant (SV) VCF file

name: paths.svs_tsv
description: Tabular representation of structural variants

name: paths.somalier_html
description: HTML report generated by Somalier for relatedness and sex checks

name: paths.coverage_vaf_html
description: HTML coverage summary and variant allele frequency (VAF) report

name: paths.work_dir
description: Path to working dir (/home/user)

name: dependencies
description: (Optional) External annotation or reference files required for extended analyses

name: dependencies.panel_app
description: PanelApp gene panel database file

name: dependencies.vep_consequences
description: VEP consequence annotation reference table

name: dependencies.phenotype_data
description: Mapping file linking phenotypes to associated genes
